sentences.text: Race for Oceans Technology is a cohort company whose country is recorded as DK, and the sources we read hold no register entry for it.
The record has two exhibitor or demo entries, dated 2024-06-30 and 2024-10-31.
It also has a first-hire record and a grant or public funding record, both for 2026 with the year only and both at low confidence.
A programme-entry record on the apelago.fi site is dated 2026-02-09.
Every readiness level is unknown, and the low-confidence funding record should not be relied on without checking it at its source.
